name: @bsi/sports-plugins
description: A curated marketplace of high-quality community sports plugins for Claude Code, Codex, and AI coding assistants
author: Austin Humphrey <Austin@BlazeSportsIntel.com>

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:vitest && npm run test:py && npm run validate
scripts.test:py: for t in plugins/*/skills/*/tests; do python3 -m unittest discover -s "$t" || exit 1; done
